title: Sons and Daughters of Saint Lucia

english.author: English Wikipedia contributors
english.note: Extracted from the English Wikipedia article cited in sources.local.note.

local: love the land that gave us birth,
land of beaches, hills and valleys,
fairest isle of all the earth.
english: love the land that gave us birth,
land of beaches, hills and valleys,
fairest isle of all the earth.

local: Love, oh, love our island home.
Gone the times when nations battled
english: Love, oh, love our island home.
Gone the times when nations battled

local: gone the days when strife and discord
dimmed her children's toil and rest.
Dawns at last a brighter day,
stretches out a glad new way.
english: gone the days when strife and discord
dimmed her children's toil and rest.
Dawns at last a brighter day,
stretches out a glad new way.

local: May the good Lord bless our island,
guard her sons from woe and harm,
strong in soul and strong in arm!
english: May the good Lord bless our island,
guard her sons from woe and harm,
strong in soul and strong in arm!
